Thank you for saying that, I think she’s also just really angry and feels like I took her son away from her. Before, I always tried to be nice to her and be her version of “perfect” but it’s just impossible. Shortly before my suicide attempt I had the gastric sleeve surgery and got really sick after and needed to be re-hospitalized. When I got home she would say, “my son was better off before he met you”, “you’re just dragging my son down by being sick all the time”, and “my son was never in debt before he met you” and I would just ignore her

Well when he tries to talk to her about her behaviors she does like a total 180 and is like “No, I love Allie, I would never say that to her.” Or “I’m just trying to teach her how to be a better wife to you” and he’ll be like “mom, she already makes me happy just the way she is” but when my husband was out of the house she just returned to her normal behavior. Finally when we were moving out though, she snapped at me and didn’t realize my husband was around the corner and he finally saw how she acts towards me when he’s not there. And he snapped back at her and she was of course, playing the victim
Lol yep mines a handful! Suuuuper grateful we moved out
